property_summary: After initialization, the nft address returned by the public getter nft() must equal the _nft argument passed to initialize; the bug sets nft to baseToken instead, so for any _nft != _baseToken the getter returns the wrong address.
change_summary: Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = baseToken;` so `nft` is set to the base token address instead of the provided NFT address.
